desktop.text: Desktop: one sticky band, 72 px tall. Name and links sit together on the left, with a single pipe after the name (Name | Home  Journey), inside the same 1200 px column as the page content. The band gets a dark translucent fill and a hairline only, so the hero still shows through.

mobile.text: Mobile: same band at 64 px. The menu panel drops from the band's bottom edge, full width, rows 56 px tall. A scrim covers the page behind it. Tapping the name, a link or the scrim closes it.
